alignments.note: Anarthrous participle rendered as a finite English clause; the subject pronoun realizes the participle's own subject and joins its unit, as rule 17 keeps a subject pronoun with its verb. Head on the lexical verb.
Construct noun with the supplied *the* under rule 29, no article morpheme standing on it.
The `לְ` marking the counted set is what the ASV's *of* renders here.
Assimilated article token takes the written *the* under rule 12.
Finite verb with its subject pronoun under rule 17.
The ASV recasts *to all of them* as the bare object *them all*, leaving the `לְ` no English word; `unrepresented` under rule 40.
Quantifier keeps only its own word; the *of* the corpus would write between quantifier and suffix is absent here, the ASV having written a bare *them all*.
Suffix realized by the object pronoun under rule 18.
Bare nominal with the supplied *by* stating what it contributes to the clause, under rule 33; the unit is discontinuous around the supplied possessive under rule 25.
No suffix or other possessive morpheme stands on `שֵׁמוֹת`, so the supplied possessive is `added` under rule 18's closing sentence; the ASV italic corroborates it, by rule 7.
